When Nancy's behavior turns violent and she suddenly vanishes, her husband is blamed, but the truth that emerges is far more terrifying than anyone imagined.

Ojigijaga puts a proposal before Jideofor. Akunna asks Nwoye the big question.

When the body of a murdered young woman is found floating in the Gulf of Mexico after three decades, her family stumbles across her description and the case is reopened.

A 911 call leads police to find Ron Whiles shot and burned in his home in Lafayette, Indiana. Police questioning leads them to one name.

A woman discovers she is adopted and asks Wolfe to help locate her birth mother. But when he digs up a secret so shocking, his client wishes it had stayed buried.
A woman desperate for a baby chooses an unorthodox pregnancy method - but has she been scammed? As Wolfe investigates, he falls into a strange world he never knew existed.
A teacher asks Wolfe to find the person harassing him but Wolfe realizes the teacher and his family face a threat more serious than some high school prank.
When Lisa Stukey has not been seen or heard from for several weeks, Police find her decomposing body inside her home. The investigation leads to a shocking discovery!
Extremely popular teenager Kathy Chou goes missing in Washington, shocking everyone. Then, a surprising tip leads to police looking at those closest to her.
Robert Henry, an executive in Tacoma, is murdered in 1995 by a masked gunman. His wife tells police she thinks he was killed by a former business associate.
When Gayle Isleib is shot dead in 1996, police identify a co-worker. Evidence is found of stalking, plans to kidnap her, murder her husband and love poems to Gayle.
A popular New Jersey teen is found murdered in her aunt's kitchen. Police investigate her relationship with a 20-year-old, exposing abuse and a tragic end.
An Auburn graduate vanishes in Alabama, and her friends grow suspicious of one another as secrets emerge and the search for answers turns inward.
